scope: Reuse cleanup, raster adjacency, repaired pixel chains and source component count across tracing tolerances. Curve fitting, noding, sampled pixels, acceptance gates and solver scheduling remain unchanged.
changes: A local prepared tracer creates independent curves and sampled masks for every tolerance. No global cache is introduced.
Topology initialization reuses that tracer and its already-computed sample when comparing simplified boundaries.

validation.comparison: All control coordinates and preprocessing metadata match the pre-change runtime exactly at five border radii; four alternating-order timing pairs per target.
validation.frozenFixtures: 48 pre-change trace/sampling outputs across four photographic masks, four straight/curved/strict-symmetry configurations and three tolerances.
validation.remaining: Full check/lint/build/test, private star/hat browser QA and fresh native Hunodan/photo/editable benchmarks.

limitations: Measured speed gain is boundary preparation only, not whole-solve throughput.
The known full-QA MILP timeout and photographic score regressions remain unresolved until independently tested.
A faster preparation does not repair a bad crop or mask or guarantee faithful motif connectivity.
